Category: Announcements
Title:    📖 Guide: Import failed or looks wrong? Fixes for the five most common causes
-->

Most import problems come from the file, not from your CV. Find yours below.

## "Import failed" on a scanned PDF

A scanned PDF is a picture of each page, so there's no text to read. Export the CV as a PDF from the
original document (Word, Google Docs, Pages), upload the DOCX instead, or save its text as a plain
`.txt` file and import that.
[More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/scanned-pdf)

## "Import failed" on a PDF with a password

A PDF that needs a password to open can't be read. Save a copy without the password, or upload the
DOCX. [More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/pdf-with-password)

## My experience was split into the wrong roles

Import tells roles apart by their headings and dates, so an unusual layout can merge two jobs or
split one. Either discard the import, tidy the file (one heading and one date range per role) and
try again, or save it and fix the roles in the editor.
[More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/sections-split-wrongly)

## My CV isn't in English

That's fine: import reads CVs in other languages too. See
[Importing a CV in another language](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/cv-in-another-language).

## I don't have the file

Paste the text instead: copy it from wherever your CV lives and import it as text.
[More →](https://rolebranch.com/help/getting-started/paste-text-instead)

## Still not working?

Open a post in [🙏 Q&A](https://github.com/Rolebranch/community/discussions/new?category=q-a)
with the file type and the exact message you saw, **but don't attach your CV here**: this is public.
If we need the file, we'll ask you to send it privately through
[rolebranch.com/help/request](https://rolebranch.com/help/request).
